class.name: OcgGeomLine
class.brief_description: Describes an infinite line. A line is defined and positioned in space with an axis (gp_Ax1 object) which gives it an origin and a unit vector. The Geom_Line line is parameterized: P (U) = O + U*Dir, where: - P is the point of parameter U, - O is the origin and Dir the unit vector of its positioning axis. The parameter range is ] -infinite, +infinite [. The orientation of the line is given by the unit vector of its positioning axis.
class.description: ! Describes an infinite line. ! A line is defined and positioned in space with an axis ! (gp_Ax1 object) which gives it an origin and a unit vector. ! The Geom_Line line is parameterized: ! P (U) = O + U*Dir, where: ! - P is the point of parameter U, ! - O is the origin and Dir the unit vector of its positioning axis. ! The parameter range is ] -infinite, +infinite [. ! The orientation of the line is given by the unit vector ! of its positioning axis.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a line located in 3D space with the axis placement A1. The Location of A1 is the origin of the line.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a line from a non transient line from package gp.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a line passing through point P and parallel to vector V (P and V are, respectively, the origin and the unit vector of the positioning axis of the line).

method.name: SetLin
method.description: Set <me> so that <me> has the same geometric properties as L.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: changes the direction of the line.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: changes the "Location" point (origin) of the line.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: changes the "Location" and a the "Direction" of <me>.

method.name: Lin
method.description: Returns non transient line from gp with the same geometric properties as <me>

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the positioning axis of this line; this is also its local coordinate system.

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Changes the orientation of this line. As a result, the unit vector of the positioning axis of this line is reversed.

method.name: ReversedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the reversed line for the point of parameter U on this line. For a line, the returned value is -U.

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the first parameter of this line. This is Standard_Real::RealFirst().

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the last parameter of this line. This is Standard_Real::RealLast().

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: returns False

method.name: IsPeriodic
method.description: returns False

method.name: Continuity
method.description: Returns GeomAbs_CN, which is the global continuity of any line.

method.name: IsCN
method.description: returns True. Raised if N < 0.

method.name: D0
method.description: Returns in P the point of parameter U. P (U) = O + U * Dir where O is the "Location" point of the line and Dir the direction of the line.

method.name: D1
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter u and the first derivative V1.

method.name: D2
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first and second derivatives V1 and V2. V2 is a vector with null magnitude for a line.

method.name: D3
method.description: V2 and V3 are vectors with null magnitude for a line.

method.name: DN
method.description: The returned vector gives the value of the derivative for the order of derivation N. Raised if N < 1.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this line.

method.name: TransformedParameter
method.description: Returns the parameter on the transformed curve for the transform of the point of parameter U on <me>.

method.name: ParametricTransformation
method.description: Returns a coefficient to compute the parameter on the transformed curve for the transform of the point on <me>.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this line.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
